purposeAndApplication.purpose: The IMB MB2005B-BA-DA-9270 is a feed-off-the-arm machine in IMB's jeans-machine line, used for denim and heavy-fabric seaming. The composite code (BA / DA suffixes) is most likely a factory / spec-configuration code denoting gauge or automation options rather than a distinct catalog model.
applications: Feed-off-the-arm chainstitch seaming on jeans and denim garments
Production lines on denim / jeans / workwear requiring a robust FOTA head
Possible lap-seaming or puller-feed variant (BA / DA suffix dependent)

finalNotes:
⚠️ IMB's published lineup lists closely related feed-off-arm models as MB2004G / MB2004H; a listing for the exact composite code "MB2005B-BA-DA-9270" was not found on IMB's public site. This is most likely a factory/spec-configuration code (BA/DA suffixes typically denote gauge or automation options) for a Feed-Off-The-Arm denim machine, with the '9270' suffix likely pointing to a Brother DA-9270-class machine.

IMB does not publish detailed numeric specs (sewing speed, stitch length) for this line publicly — best confirmed via IMB Bangladesh (sales@imb-bd.com) or the IMB catalogue.
